dedupe_keys.name: zindi barbados traffic analysis four camera video of the norman niles roundabout labelled with entry and exit congestion levels

description: The Barbados Traffic Analysis Challenge on Zindi (November 2025 to January 2026) was set up with Barbados' Ministry of Transport and Works, GovTech Barbados and Keleya Labs to predict congestion at a roundabout and find its root causes. Contents: video from four cameras covering the four entrances and exits of the Norman Niles roundabout, split into roughly one-minute segments synchronised across cameras and labelled with entry and exit congestion ratings (free flowing, light delay, moderate delay, heavy delay); models must engineer features such as flow rate, vehicle counts and entry and exit timing from raw video and predict congestion five minutes ahead. Producer: Zindi with the Barbados Ministry of Transport and Works, GovTech Barbados and Keleya Labs. Coverage: one roundabout in Barbados. Format and access: Train and test segment tables, a notebook to read videos from a Google Cloud bucket, a data archive and a torrent option from Zindi after joining. Licence: challenge data may be accessed, used and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 according to the challenge rules. Caveats: a single junction and subjective congestion labels; back-propagation was not allowed in the challenge. Simulation uses: junction capacity and congestion analysis, video-based traffic counting and calibration of microsimulation models. Related records: none for Barbados roads in the catalogue.
